summary.motive: Bait opposing quarterbacks into throwing standard Cover 3 beaters (out routes and sail concepts) by feigning a single-high middle-of-field-closed shell before spinning into a deadly Cover 6 corner trap.
summary.keyDefender: LCB (Trap Corner) & SS (Disguised deep half safety)
summary.whyItWorks: The QB confirms single-high coverage pre-snap and immediately targets the out route against what he expects to be a retreating deep-third corner; the corner squats and jumps the route untouched.
summary.failureMode: Quick seam throws into the safety rotation void if the QB recognizes the post-snap spin immediately.

beats.title: Pre-Snap Single-High Illusion
beats.text: Macdonald aligns in what looks like standard single-high Cover 3 Sky (FS deep in middle, SS rolled down into box). The QB identifies single-high and dials up an out route.

beats.title: Post-Snap Safety Inversion (The Spin)
beats.text: At the snap, the safeties spin! SS explodes backward to cover the boundary deep half, while FS rotates to the field quarter. LCB recognizes the trap trigger.

beats.title: The Trap Snaps Shut: Corner Interception
beats.text: As X clears out downfield, LCB lets him go to SS and squats aggressively on H’s out route. The QB throws directly into the trap for a catastrophic pick-six.

beats.title: Defensive Touchdown Return
beats.text: LCB undercuts the football with full forward momentum, sprinting down the sideline for a game-changing defensive score.

relations.tell: Free safety spins from middle-of-field-closed to deep half post-snap, triggering corner trap
